projection: Equirectangular 2:1 map; front photosphere from NASA SDO HMI continuum

photosphere.source: NASA/GSFC SDO HMI Intensitygram Continuum (HMIIC) latest 4096px disk
photosphere.colorTreatment: neutral warm continuum grade; source false-color orange LUT removed
photosphere.farSideBase: neutral procedural photosphere base; this is not presented as an image

height.source: NASA SDO HMI intensity continuum contrast
height.encoding: 8-bit grayscale, 128 = average photosphere, below 128 = dark sunspot depression, above 128 = small facular/granular raised texture
height.geometryRelief: visualized with a documented 4x approximate Wilson-depression/facular exaggeration; not kilometer-accurate height survey

farSideEUV.source: NASA STEREO-B SECCHI/EUVI final usable Behind full-disk browse observations
farSideEUV.interpretation: Actual archived EUV images of the far hemisphere; false-colour composite for visualization, not visible-light photosphere. STEREO-B contact was lost in 2014.

hmiMagnetogram.source: NASA SDO/HMI full-disk colorized line-of-sight magnetic field quick-look

aia131.source: NASA SDO/AIA 131 angstrom full-disk latest image
aia131.interpretation: Hot flare plasma and active-region emission; false color, not visible-light color

aia171.source: NASA SDO/AIA 171 angstrom full-disk latest image
aia171.interpretation: Coronal loops and million-degree plasma; false color

aia193.source: NASA SDO/AIA 193 angstrom full-disk latest image
aia193.interpretation: Coronal active regions and hotter plasma; false color

aia304.source: NASA SDO/AIA 304 angstrom full-disk latest image

visualization.magneticLoops: 3D arcs are generated from opposite-polarity clusters in the HMI line-of-sight magnetogram; they are a visualization, not a PFSS extrapolation or measured 3D magnetic vector field
visualization.coronalShell: Animated depth-layered projection of observed AIA 131, 171, 193 and 304 full-disk data
visualization.photosphere: Warm visible-light grade of the SDO/HMI continuum; AIA channel colors remain false-color physical diagnostics
visualization.refresh: This release contains a timestamped local snapshot. It does not yet provide a guaranteed automatic three-minute refresh; the HMI and AIA products have different acquisition/processing times.
